tasks.title: Project scaffolding, Go module, dependencies, and Dockerfile
tasks.description: Initialize Go module, add required dependencies, create directory structure, and setup multi-stage Dockerfile for Alpine.
tasks.details: Initialize Go module github.com/example/3proxy-backend with Go 1.22. Add dependencies: github.com/gin-gonic/gin, gorm.io/gorm, modernc.org/sqlite, github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v5, golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt, github.com/go-ini/ini. Create directory structure: cmd/server/main.go, internal/api/, internal/service/, internal/repository/, internal/scheduler/, internal/docker/, internal/parser/, internal/config/, internal/logger/. Create multi-stage Dockerfile: build stage golang:1.22-alpine running go build -o server, runtime stage alpine:latest copying binary and ca-certificates. Implement main.go skeleton with flag parsing and server setup.
tasks.testStrategy: Run go build ./... and go vet ./... to verify compilation. Build Docker image and verify binary runs on Alpine. Confirm directory structure matches PRD section 7.

tasks.title: Environment configuration loader and structured logging
tasks.description: Load all settings from environment variables and implement structured JSON logger.
tasks.details: Create internal/config/config.go with Config struct containing all env vars from FR-16: DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, PROXY_DOMAIN, HTTP_PORT, SOCKS_PORT, PROXYAUTH_PATH, LOGS_DIR, SYNC_INFO_FILE, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, PROXY_CONTAINER_NAME, SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE. Load from environment with defaults using os.Getenv. Validate required fields on startup. Create internal/logger/logger.go with structured JSON logger outputting level, timestamp, message, and fields at debug/info/warn/error levels.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test config loading with missing required env vars returns error. Verify defaults applied for optional fields. Capture logger output and verify JSON contains level, timestamp, message, fields keys.

tasks.title: SQLite database connection, GORM setup, and auto-migration
tasks.description: Connect to SQLite via GORM using pure Go driver, enable WAL mode, and auto-migrate schema on startup.
tasks.details: Initialize GORM database connection using modernc.org/sqlite pure Go driver (no CGO). Open DATABASE_URL with query parameters _journal_mode=WAL, _busy_timeout=5000, _foreign_keys=1. Configure connection pool (MaxOpenConns, MaxIdleConns). Implement AutoMigrate on startup for GORM models matching Prisma schema: User, Server, ProxyUser, ConfigVersion. Create DB singleton accessible via repository layer.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test using temporary SQLite file. Verify AutoMigrate creates all expected tables. Verify PRAGMA journal_mode returns WAL. Verify concurrent writes do not cause permanent database locked errors.

tasks.title: GORM models and repository layer
tasks.description: Define GORM models matching Prisma schema and implement repository interfaces for CRUD operations.
tasks.details: Define GORM models matching Prisma schema: User (ID, Username, Password, IsAdmin, SessionVersion, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt), ProxyUser (ID, Username, Password, DataUsed, DataLimit, ExpiresAt, IsActive, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt), Server, ConfigVersion. Implement repository interfaces and GORM implementations: UserRepository (GetByUsername, Create, Update, BumpSessionVersion), ProxyUserRepository (List with pagination/filtering, Create, Update, Delete, GetByID), ConfigRepository. Add bcrypt utilities: HashPassword (cost 10), CheckPasswordHash.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test repository CRUD against test SQLite database. Verify bcrypt hash cost is 10. Verify CheckPasswordHash returns true for correct password, false for incorrect. Verify username uniqueness constraints.

tasks.title: Authentication core service: JWT, bcrypt, rate limiting
tasks.description: Implement JWT HS256 token service, bcrypt password verification, and per-username rate limiting with exponential backoff.
tasks.details: Implement AuthService: Login(username, password) validates credentials via UserRepository, returns JWT token and user. GenerateToken(user) creates HS256 JWT with claims: sub=userID, aud, iss, sessionVersion from DB, exp. ValidateToken(token) verifies signature, audience, issuer, and sessionVersion against database. Implement rate limiter per username with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s...) using sync.Map and mutex. Return generic 401 for invalid credentials without user enumeration.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test JWT generation and validation with tampered signature, wrong audience, wrong issuer, stale sessionVersion. Test rate limiter blocks after N failed attempts with exponential backoff timing. Test Login returns identical 401 for existing and non-existing users.

tasks.title: Authentication API handlers
tasks.description: Implement login, session, logout, and change-credentials endpoints with cookie handling.
tasks.details: Implement Gin handlers: POST /api/auth/login accepts JSON {username, password}, sets session cookie (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax) with JWT, returns user info. GET /api/auth/session returns {isAuthorized, userId, username}. POST /api/auth/logout clears cookie and returns success. POST /api/auth/change-credentials verifies current password, updates username/password, bumps sessionVersion via repository, issues new JWT cookie. Match exact JSON response shapes from existing Next.js API routes.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test handlers with mock AuthService. Verify cookie attributes (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax). Verify session endpoint returns correct shape. Verify change-credentials bumps sessionVersion and old token fails validation. Verify JSON response keys match frontend expectations.

tasks.title: Authentication and authorization middleware
tasks.description: Implement JWT validation middleware and admin authorization middleware.
tasks.details: Create Gin middleware: AuthMiddleware extracts JWT from session cookie, validates via AuthService, stores user claims in context, returns 401 on missing/invalid token. AdminMiddleware checks user.IsAdmin from database, returns 403 if not admin. Apply middleware to protected route groups.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test middleware with valid, expired, and missing tokens. Verify 401 for unauthenticated requests. Verify 403 for non-admin users on admin endpoints. Verify user claims available in context for downstream handlers.

tasks.title: Proxy user service and .proxyauth management
tasks.description: Implement proxy user CRUD business logic, username validation, plaintext password storage, and atomic .proxyauth generation.
tasks.details: Implement ProxyUserService with CRUD operations. Validate username pattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$. Store password as plaintext for 3proxy CRYPT-MD5 (no bcrypt hashing for proxy users). Implement GenerateProxyAuth() that reads all active ProxyUsers, writes .proxyauth atomically (write to temp file, os.Rename), compares file signature/hash to avoid unnecessary reloads. On Create/Update/Delete, regenerate .proxyauth and trigger 3proxy reload via DockerService.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test username validation regex accepts alphanumeric+._- and rejects special characters. Verify .proxyauth file format matches expected 3proxy format. Verify atomic write leaves no temp files on failure. Verify service calls reload after user mutations.

tasks.title: Proxy user API handlers
tasks.description: Implement GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/users with pagination and filtering.
tasks.details: Implement Gin handlers: GET /api/admin/users with pagination (page, pageSize) and filtering (username, isActive), returns users without password field. POST /api/admin/users creates user, validates input, returns created user. PUT /api/admin/users/:id updates fields. DELETE /api/admin/users/:id removes user. All return appropriate 400/404/500 statuses.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test handlers with mock ProxyUserService. Verify password excluded from list response. Verify pagination parameters applied. Verify 400 on invalid username pattern. Verify 404 on non-existent user ID.

tasks.title: 3proxy Docker container integration service
tasks.description: Implement Docker API client for detecting and restarting/reloading the 3proxy container.
tasks.details: Implement DockerService using Docker API (github.com/docker/docker/client or direct HTTP). Methods: ContainerExists(name), RestartContainer(name), ReloadContainer(name). Container name resolution order: PROXY_CONTAINER_NAME env var, '3proxy', 'vpn-3proxy'. If container not found, log warning and return gracefully without error.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test with mock Docker client. Verify name resolution order. Verify warning logged when container missing. Verify restart/reload API calls made with correct container name.

tasks.title: Configuration API handlers
tasks.description: Implement config generate, reload, and runtime proxy-config endpoints.
tasks.details: Implement handlers: GET /api/config/generate queries active ProxyUsers with limits, returns JSON array. POST /api/config/reload calls ProxyUserService.GenerateProxyAuth() then DockerService.ReloadContainer(). GET /api/proxy-config returns {domain, httpPort, socksPort} from config environment variables.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test handlers. Verify config generate returns only active users with limit fields. Verify reload triggers service and docker methods. Verify proxy-config returns env values exactly.

tasks.title: 3proxy log parser service
tasks.description: Implement streaming parsers for 3proxy logs (JSON and text formats) and traffic aggregation.
tasks.details: Implement LogParserService with streaming parsers for 3proxy log formats (JSON lines and text format). Parse fields: timestamp, username, IP, bytesSent, bytesReceived, requestType. Implement AggregateTraffic(entries) returning per-username/IP totals (requests, sent, received). Implement ReadNewBytes(filePath, lastInode, lastOffset) using os.Stat and file seeking for incremental reads. Use bufio.Reader for streaming to handle 100MB+ logs without loading into memory.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test parser with sample 3proxy log lines in both JSON and text formats. Verify field extraction accuracy. Verify aggregation sums correctly. Test streaming with 100MB+ file verifies constant memory usage.

tasks.title: Logs API handler
tasks.description: Implement GET /api/logs with filtering, pagination, and statistics.
tasks.details: Implement GET /api/logs handler accepting query params: startDate, endDate, username, logType, limit, offset. Scan log files in LOGS_DIR, parse entries via LogParserService, apply filters, paginate results. Return {entries, totalCount, filesScanned, availableDates, stats} matching existing API response shape.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test handler with mock parser. Verify date range filtering. Verify username filtering. Verify pagination limit/offset. Verify response includes totalCount and filesScanned.

tasks.title: Traffic API handler with caching
tasks.description: Implement GET /api/users/traffic returning aggregated traffic with 30-second cache.
tasks.details: Implement GET /api/users/traffic handler. Call LogParserService to aggregate traffic from logs. Implement in-memory cache with 30-second TTL using sync.RWMutex and expiration map. Return aggregated traffic per username/IP: {username, ip, requests, sent, received}.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test cache expiration: verify data refreshed after 30 seconds. Verify aggregation matches parser output. Test concurrent cache reads/writes safety with race detector.

tasks.title: Maintenance job service
tasks.description: Implement atomic maintenance job: log processing, traffic updates, user deactivation, Telegram notifications, .proxyauth regeneration, and 3proxy reload.
tasks.details: Implement MaintenanceService with sync.Mutex for atomic execution. RunMaintenance(): read SYNC_INFO_FILE for last inode+offset per log file, read new bytes via LogParserService, aggregate traffic, update ProxyUser.dataUsed in database via short transactions, deactivate users where dataUsed >= dataLimit or ExpiresAt < now, send Telegram notification (Markdown) to TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN/telegramUserId for each deactivated user, regenerate .proxyauth, reload 3proxy. Update SYNC_INFO_FILE with new inode+offset. Retry on database busy errors.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test maintenance logic with mock dependencies. Verify mutex prevents concurrent execution. Verify deactivation logic for data limit and expiry. Verify Telegram message format is Markdown. Verify .proxyauth regeneration and reload called after maintenance.

tasks.title: Maintenance scheduler
tasks.description: Implement cron-like runner that triggers maintenance every minute.
tasks.details: Implement Scheduler with time.Ticker firing every minute. On each tick, attempt MaintenanceService.RunMaintenance() if mutex is available (non-blocking lock). Handle graceful shutdown via context. Log scheduler start/stop and maintenance run results.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test scheduler interval using fake clock or short interval. Verify maintenance called approximately every minute. Verify shutdown stops ticker and completes running maintenance.

tasks.title: System status and health check handlers
tasks.description: Implement GET /api/health and GET /api/system/status endpoints.
tasks.details: Implement handlers: GET /api/health returns {status: 'ok', timestamp, uptime} with server start time. GET /api/system/status returns composite status: 3proxy running state/version/memory/PID via DockerService, config file info, user count from DB, proxyauth file stats (size, mod time), disk usage for LOGS_DIR, traffic sync info from SYNC_INFO_FILE.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test handlers. Verify health returns status ok and uptime > 0. Verify system status aggregates data from Docker, DB, and file system. Verify graceful handling when 3proxy container unavailable.

tasks.title: Main entry point, router setup, and server wiring
tasks.description: Wire all services, middleware, and routes into the Gin HTTP server with graceful shutdown.
tasks.details: Create cmd/server/main.go entry point: load config, initialize logger, connect to database with auto-migration, initialize repositories and services, setup Gin router with middleware (structured logger, CORS, recovery, auth middleware), register route groups (auth, admin, config, logs, traffic, system), start HTTP server on configured port with graceful shutdown (Shutdown with timeout on SIGINT/SIGTERM), start maintenance scheduler in goroutine.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test: start server on test port, perform full cycle login → create user → generate traffic → maintenance → verify endpoints. Send SIGTERM and verify graceful shutdown completes within timeout. Verify all routes registered and respond.

tasks.title: Initialize Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind + HeroUI project
tasks.description: Create the frontend/ directory and set up a Vite-based React 19 application with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and HeroUI.
tasks.details: Run `npm create vite@latest frontend -- --template react-ts`. Install Tailwind CSS v4, HeroUI, React Router DOM, axios, react-toastify. Configure `vite.config.ts` with server port 3000, build output directory `dist`, and plugins for Tailwind and HeroUI. Add `tsconfig.json` with strict settings and include paths for `@/` alias.
tasks.testStrategy: Execute `npm run dev` and verify the dev server starts on http://localhost:3000. Run `npm run build` and confirm the `dist/` directory is generated.

tasks.title: Copy UI components, hooks, and core utilities
tasks.description: Migrate all existing UI components, custom hooks, and core definition/utility files from the Next.js app to the new React app, removing Next.js-specific imports.
tasks.details: Copy `src/components/*` → `frontend/src/components/`, `src/hooks/*` → `frontend/src/hooks/`, `src/core/definitions.ts` → `frontend/src/types/`, `src/core/utils.ts` → `frontend/src/utils/`, `src/core/toast-utils.ts` → `frontend/src/utils/toast-utils.ts`. Replace imports of `next/navigation`, `next/image`, `next-themes` with React equivalents (e.g., `useNavigate` from react-router-dom, standard ``, custom theme hook). Convert any server components to client components by adding `'use client'` directive.
tasks.testStrategy: Run ESLint with a rule banning `next/` imports and ensure no violations. Render each component on a test page to confirm no runtime errors.

tasks.title: Create API client layer
tasks.description: Implement a centralized API client using axios to communicate with the Go backend.
tasks.details: Create `frontend/src/api/client.ts`. Configure axios instance with `baseURL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8080'` and `withCredentials: true`. Add request interceptor for auth token if needed, and response interceptor for error handling (e.g., 401 → redirect to login). Export typed functions for each API endpoint.
tasks.testStrategy: Use MSW or mock server to intercept requests, verify base URL and credentials are sent. Write unit tests for each endpoint function.

tasks.title: Set up React Router routes and convert pages
tasks.description: Create router configuration mapping URLs to migrated page components, replicating the Next.js App Router structure.
tasks.details: Create `frontend/src/routes.tsx` using `createBrowserRouter`. Define routes for `/`, `/admin/dashboard`, `/admin/users`, `/admin/users/create`, `/admin/users/:id/edit`, `/admin/profile`. Copy each page from `src/app/` into `frontend/src/pages/`, converting server-component logic (e.g., `fetch` on server) to `useEffect`/`useQuery` hooks. Wrap the router in `ThemeProvider` and `ToastProvider`.
tasks.testStrategy: Start dev server, navigate to each route in a browser, and verify correct page renders without 404. Use React Router's `useLocation` to assert path changes.

tasks.title: Implement authentication flow
tasks.description: Add login, session validation, logout, and change-credentials functionality using the Go backend endpoints.
tasks.details: Create `frontend/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx` context that fetches `GET /api/auth/session` on mount. Implement login page calling `POST /api/auth/login`, logout via `POST /api/auth/logout`, and change-credentials via `PUT /api/auth/change-credentials`. Protect routes by redirecting to `/login` when session is invalid.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform end-to-end test: start dev server, log in with valid credentials, verify session persists on page reload, log out, ensure redirect to login. Test invalid credentials show error toast.

tasks.title: Implement admin user management
tasks.description: Create hooks and UI for listing, creating, editing, deleting users and sharing passwords.
tasks.details: Develop `frontend/src/hooks/useUsers.ts` with functions for `GET /api/admin/users`, `POST /api/admin/users`, `PUT /api/admin/users/:id`, `DELETE /api/admin/users/:id`, `GET /api/admin/users/:id/share`. Connect to admin pages, implement pagination, filtering, and toast notifications on success/error.
tasks.testStrategy: Run integration tests against a running Go backend: create a user, verify list includes it, edit user, delete user, check share password endpoint returns password.

tasks.title: Implement config management
tasks.description: Add pages for generating, reloading config and fetching proxy config.
tasks.details: Create `frontend/src/hooks/useConfig.ts` with `GET /api/config/generate`, `POST /api/config/reload`, `GET /api/proxy-config`. Bind to UI components, show loading states and toasts.
tasks.testStrategy: Call generate endpoint, verify response; trigger reload, confirm success toast; fetch proxy config, display data.

tasks.title: Implement logs viewer
tasks.description: Build logs page with filters, pagination, and infinite scroll.
tasks.details: Create `frontend/src/hooks/useLogs.ts` to fetch `GET /api/logs` with query params for date, username, type. Implement infinite scroll using IntersectionObserver. Display available dates and stats from endpoint.
tasks.testStrategy: Load logs page, apply filters, verify data updates; scroll to bottom to trigger more fetches.

tasks.title: Implement traffic monitoring page
tasks.description: Show aggregated traffic data per user with auto-refresh.
tasks.details: Create `frontend/src/hooks/useTraffic.ts` calling `GET /api/users/traffic`. Use `setInterval` to refresh every 30 seconds. Cache results in memory. Display data in charts/tables.
tasks.testStrategy: Navigate to traffic page, verify data loads, wait 30s, confirm data updates.

tasks.title: Implement system status page
tasks.description: Display proxy status, version, memory, config, users count, proxyauth info, logs disk usage.
tasks.details: Create `frontend/src/hooks/useSystemStatus.ts` for `GET /api/system/status` and `GET /api/health`. Populate UI components with returned data.
tasks.testStrategy: Load status page, verify all fields are populated correctly.

tasks.title: Implement manual maintenance trigger
tasks.description: Add button in admin panel to trigger maintenance via `POST /api/users/maintenance`.
tasks.details: Create `frontend/src/hooks/useMaintenance.ts` with function to call endpoint. Show success/error toast.
tasks.testStrategy: Click trigger button, verify toast appears and backend executes maintenance.

tasks.title: Implement theme switching and toast notifications
tasks.description: Replace next-themes with localStorage-based theme toggle and integrate react-toastify.
tasks.details: Create `frontend/src/theme/ThemeContext.tsx` that toggles `dark` class on `<html>` and persists to localStorage. Add `ToastContainer` from react-toastify in root component. Update components to use theme context.
tasks.testStrategy: Toggle theme, verify class changes and persists after reload; trigger a toast, verify display.

tasks.title: Set up environment configuration
tasks.description: Create `.env.example` and ensure build-time env injection works.
tasks.details: Add `frontend/.env.example` with `VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8080`. Configure Vite to expose env variables via `import.meta.env`. Update API client to use `import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL`.
tasks.testStrategy: Copy `.env.example` to `.env`, modify value, run build, verify compiled code uses correct URL.

tasks.title: Add Docker support
tasks.description: Create Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml for frontend.
tasks.details: Write multi-stage Dockerfile: build stage uses node:20 to run `npm run build`, then copy `dist/` to nginx:alpine. Configure nginx to serve SPA and proxy `/api/*` to Go backend. Add `docker-compose.yml` with services for frontend and backend.
tasks.testStrategy: Run `docker compose up --build`, verify frontend loads in browser and API calls proxy to backend.

tasks.title: Perform integration and smoke testing
tasks.description: Execute end-to-end smoke test covering core user flows.
tasks.details: Start dev server, log in, create a user, verify user appears in list, check config generation, logs, traffic, system status, and maintenance trigger. Ensure theme toggle and toasts work.
tasks.testStrategy: Manual test script or automated Cypress script; record results.
